title: AdLayoutOptimizerInput
description: Page layout descriptor for ad viewability and Better Ads Standards analysis.

device_type.description: Target device form factor for layout evaluation.

ad_density_percentage.description: Percentage of total page height occupied by ad slots.

position.description: Slot placement descriptor. Known values: top, atf, above-fold, sidebar, mid, btf, footer, interstitial, sticky, overlay, popup. Unknown values are treated as btf.

size.description: Ad unit size in WxH format (e.g. '320x250', '728x90', '300x600').

is_lazy.description: Whether lazy loading is enabled for this slot.

current_ad_slots.description: Array of current ad slot descriptors on the page.
